File: src/context/subscription.provider.tsx

"use client";
import React, {
  createContext,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useState,
  useCallback,
} from "react";
import { useAuth } from "./auth.provider";
import api from "@/lib/api";
import { ISubscription } from "@/typings/ISubscription";

interface SubscriptionContextType {
  subscriptions: ISubscription[];
  isLoading: boolean;
  isError: boolean;
  refetch: () => void;
  isSubscribedTo: (creatorId: string) => boolean;
}

const SubscriptionContext = createContext<SubscriptionContextType>({
  subscriptions: [],
  isLoading: false,
  isError: false,
  refetch: () => {},
  isSubscribedTo: () => false,
});

export const useSubscription = () => useContext(SubscriptionContext);

export const SubscriptionProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({
  children,
}) => {
  const [subscriptions, setSubscriptions] = useState<ISubscription[]>([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isError, setIsError] = useState(false);
  const { user } = useAuth();

  const fetchSubscriptions = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!user) {
      setSubscriptions([]);
      setIsLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    setIsLoading(true);
    setIsError(false);

    try {
      const response = await api.get("/users/subscriptions");
      if (response.data && response.data.activeSubscriptions) {
        setSubscriptions(response.data.activeSubscriptions);
      } else {
        setSubscriptions([]);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error fetching subscriptions:", error);
      setIsError(true);
      setSubscriptions([]);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  }, [user]);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchSubscriptions();
  }, [user, fetchSubscriptions]);

  const isSubscribedTo = (creatorId: string): boolean => {
    if (!subscriptions.length) return false;

    return subscriptions.some(
      (subscription) =>
        subscription.creator._id === creatorId &&
        subscription.status === "active"
    );
  };

  return (
    <SubscriptionContext.Provider
      value={{
        subscriptions,
        isLoading,
        isError,
        refetch: fetchSubscriptions,
        isSubscribedTo,
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </SubscriptionContext.Provider>
  );
};

================
File: src/context/user-notifications.provider.tsx
================
"use client";
import React, {
  createContext,
  useCallback,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useState,
} from "react";
import {
  fetchNotifications,
  getUnreadCount,
  markAsRead,
  markAllAsRead,
} from "@/lib/backend-services/notifications-service";
import {
  NotificationFilterDto,
  NotificationResponseDto,
} from "@/typings/INotification";
import { useAuth } from "@/context/auth.provider";

interface UserNotificationsContextType {
  notifications: NotificationResponseDto[];
  unreadCount: number;
  isLoading: boolean;
  error: Error | null;
  fetchMoreNotifications: (filters?: NotificationFilterDto) => Promise<void>;
  markNotificationAsRead: (id: string) => Promise<void>;
  markAllNotificationsAsRead: () => Promise<void>;
  refetchNotifications: (filters?: NotificationFilterDto) => Promise<void>;
}

const UserNotificationsContext = createContext<
  UserNotificationsContextType | undefined
>(undefined);

export function UserNotificationsProvider({
  children,
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  const [notifications, setNotifications] = useState<NotificationResponseDto[]>(
    []
  );
  const [unreadCount, setUnreadCount] = useState<number>(0);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<Error | null>(null);
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState<number>(1);
  const [hasMore, setHasMore] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const { user } = useAuth();

  const [currentFilters, setCurrentFilters] = useState<NotificationFilterDto>(
    {}
  );

  const fetchUserNotifications = useCallback(
    async (filters: NotificationFilterDto = {}) => {
      if (!user) return;
      setIsLoading(true);
      setError(null);

      const mergedFilters = {
        ...currentFilters,
        ...filters,
        page: filters.page || currentPage,
        limit: 10,
      };

      if (filters.type !== undefined) {
        setCurrentFilters((prev) => ({ ...prev, type: filters.type }));
      } else if (filters.type === undefined && "type" in filters) {
        setCurrentFilters((prev) => {
          const updated = { ...prev };
          delete updated.type;
          return updated;
        });
      }

      try {
        const data = await fetchNotifications(mergedFilters);

        setNotifications((prevNotifications) =>
          mergedFilters.page === 1
            ? data.notifications
            : [...prevNotifications, ...data.notifications]
        );

        setUnreadCount(data.unreadCount);
        setHasMore(data.notifications.length === 10);
      } catch (err: any) {
        setError(err);
        console.error("Error fetching notifications:", err);
      } finally {
        setIsLoading(false);
      }
    },
    [currentFilters, currentPage, user]
  );

  const fetchMoreNotifications = async (
    filters: NotificationFilterDto = {}
  ) => {
    if (!hasMore || isLoading) return;
    const nextPage = currentPage + 1;
    setCurrentPage(nextPage);
    await fetchUserNotifications({
      ...currentFilters,
      ...filters,
      page: nextPage,
    });
  };

  const markNotificationAsRead = async (id: string) => {
    try {
      const success = await markAsRead([id]);
      if (success) {
        setNotifications((prev) =>
          prev.map((notif) =>
            notif.id === id ? { ...notif, isRead: true } : notif
          )
        );
        setUnreadCount((prev) => Math.max(0, prev - 1));
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Error marking notification as read:", err);
    }
  };

  const markAllNotificationsAsRead = async () => {
    try {
      const success = await markAllAsRead();
      if (success) {
        setNotifications((prev) =>
          prev.map((notif) => ({ ...notif, isRead: true }))
        );
        setUnreadCount(0);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Error marking all notifications as read:", err);
    }
  };

  const refetchNotifications = useCallback(
    async (filters: NotificationFilterDto = {}) => {
      setCurrentPage(1);
      await fetchUserNotifications({ ...filters, page: 1 });
    },
    [fetchUserNotifications]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (user) {
      fetchUserNotifications();
    }
  }, [user, fetchUserNotifications]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user) return;

    const fetchUnreadCount = async () => {
      try {
        const count = await getUnreadCount();
        if (count > unreadCount) {
          refetchNotifications();
        } else {
          setUnreadCount(count);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Error polling notifications:", err);
      }
    };

    const intervalId = setInterval(fetchUnreadCount, 60000);
    return () => clearInterval(intervalId);
  }, [user, unreadCount, refetchNotifications]);

  const value = {
    notifications,
    unreadCount,
    isLoading,
    error,
    fetchMoreNotifications,
    markNotificationAsRead,
    markAllNotificationsAsRead,
    refetchNotifications,
  };

  return (
    <UserNotificationsContext.Provider value={value}>
      {children}
    </UserNotificationsContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useUserNotifications() {
  const context = useContext(UserNotificationsContext);
  if (context === undefined) {
    throw new Error(
      "useUserNotifications must be used within a UserNotificationsProvider"
    );
  }
  return context;
}

================
File: src/context/members-provider.tsx
================
"use client";
import React, {
	createContext,
	useContext,
	useState,
	useCallback,
	ReactNode,
	useMemo,
} from "react";
import {
	MemberFilterParams,
	Member,
	fetchMembers,
	exportMembersToCSV,
} from "@/lib/backend-services/members-service";

interface MembersContextType {
	members: Member[];
	pagination: {
		total: number;
		page: number;
		limit: number;
		totalPages: number;
	} | null;
	filters: MemberFilterParams;
	isLoading: boolean;
	error: Error | null;
	selectedMembers: string[];
	setSelectedMembers: (members: string[]) => void;
	updateFilters: (newFilters: Partial<MemberFilterParams>) => void;
	nextPage: () => void;
	prevPage: () => void;
	resetFilters: () => void;
	refetch: () => Promise<void>;
	exportToCSV: () => Promise<void>;
}

const MembersContext = createContext<MembersContextType | undefined>(undefined);

interface MembersProviderProps {
	children: ReactNode;
	initialFilters?: MemberFilterParams;
}

export function MembersProvider({
	children,
	initialFilters,
}: MembersProviderProps) {
	const defaultFilters: MemberFilterParams = useMemo(
		() => ({
			page: 1,
			limit: 10,
			sortBy: "joinDate",
			sortOrder: "desc",
			...initialFilters,
		}),
		[initialFilters]
	);

	const [filters, setFilters] = useState<MemberFilterParams>(defaultFilters);
	const [membersData, setMembersData] = useState<{
		members: Member[];
		pagination: {
			total: number;
			page: number;
			limit: number;
			totalPages: number;
		};
	} | null>(null);
	const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
	const [error, setError] = useState<Error | null>(null);
	const [selectedMembers, setSelectedMembers] = useState<string[]>([]);

	const fetchMembersData = useCallback(async () => {
		setIsLoading(true);
		setError(null);
		try {
			const response = await fetchMembers(filters);
			setMembersData(response);
		} catch (err: any) {
			setError(err);
			console.error("Error fetching members:", err);
		} finally {
			setIsLoading(false);
		}
	}, [filters]);

	React.useEffect(() => {
		fetchMembersData();
	}, [fetchMembersData]);

	const updateFilters = useCallback(
		(newFilters: Partial<MemberFilterParams>) => {
			setFilters((prev) => ({
				...prev,
				...newFilters,
				page: newFilters.page !== undefined ? newFilters.page : 1,
			}));
			setSelectedMembers([]);
		},
		[]
	);

	const nextPage = useCallback(() => {
		if (
			membersData &&
			filters.page &&
			filters.page < membersData.pagination.totalPages
		) {
			setFilters((prev) => ({
				...prev,
				page: (prev.page || 1) + 1,
			}));
			setSelectedMembers([]);
		}
	}, [membersData, filters.page]);

	const prevPage = useCallback(() => {
		if (filters.page && filters.page > 1) {
			setFilters((prev) => ({
				...prev,
				page: (prev.page || 2) - 1,
			}));
			setSelectedMembers([]);
		}
	}, [filters.page]);

	const resetFilters = useCallback(() => {
		setFilters(defaultFilters);
		setSelectedMembers([]);
	}, [defaultFilters]);

	const exportToCSV = useCallback(async () => {
		try {
			const blob = await exportMembersToCSV(filters);

			// Create a download link and trigger it
			const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
			const link = document.createElement("a");
			link.href = url;
			link.setAttribute(
				"download",
				`members-export-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.csv`
			);
			document.body.appendChild(link);
			link.click();

			// Clean up
			if (link.parentNode) {
				link.parentNode.removeChild(link);
			}
			window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
		} catch (err: any) {
			console.error("Error exporting members to CSV:", err);
			setError(err);
		}
	}, [filters]);

	const value: MembersContextType = {
		members: membersData?.members || [],
		pagination: membersData?.pagination || null,
		filters,
		isLoading,
		error,
		selectedMembers,
		setSelectedMembers,
		updateFilters,
		nextPage,
		prevPage,
		resetFilters,
		refetch: fetchMembersData,
		exportToCSV,
	};

	return (
		<MembersContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</MembersContext.Provider>
	);
}

export function useMembers() {
	const context = useContext(MembersContext);
	if (context === undefined) {
		throw new Error("useMembers must be used within a MembersProvider");
	}
	return context;
}

File: src/context/notifications.provider.tsx

"use client";
import React, {
	createContext,
	useCallback,
	useContext,
	useEffect,
	useState,
} from "react";
import {
	fetchNotifications,
	getUnreadCount,
	markAsRead,
	markAllAsRead,
	deleteNotification,
} from "@/lib/backend-services/notifications-service";
import {
	NotificationFilterDto,
	NotificationResponseDto,
} from "@/typings/INotification";
import { useAuth } from "@/context/auth.provider";

interface NotificationsContextType {
	notifications: NotificationResponseDto[];
	unreadCount: number;
	isLoading: boolean;
	error: Error | null;
	fetchMoreNotifications: (filters?: NotificationFilterDto) => Promise<void>;
	markNotificationAsRead: (id: string) => Promise<void>;
	markAllNotificationsAsRead: () => Promise<void>;
	deleteUserNotification: (id: string) => Promise<void>;
	refetchNotifications: (filters?: NotificationFilterDto) => Promise<void>;
}

const NotificationsContext = createContext<
	NotificationsContextType | undefined
>(undefined);

export function NotificationsProvider({
	children,
}: {
	children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
	const [notifications, setNotifications] = useState<NotificationResponseDto[]>(
		[]
	);
	const [unreadCount, setUnreadCount] = useState<number>(0);
	const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);
	const [error, setError] = useState<Error | null>(null);
	const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState<number>(1);
	const [hasMore, setHasMore] = useState<boolean>(true);
	const { user } = useAuth();

	const [currentFilters, setCurrentFilters] = useState<NotificationFilterDto>(
		{}
	);

	const fetchUserNotifications = useCallback(
		async (filters: NotificationFilterDto = {}) => {
			if (!user) return;
			console.log({ filters });
			setIsLoading(true);
			setError(null);

			const mergedFilters = {
				...currentFilters,
				...filters,
				page: filters.page || currentPage,
				limit: 10,
			};

			if (filters.type !== undefined) {
				setCurrentFilters((prev) => ({ ...prev, type: filters.type }));
			} else if (filters.type === undefined && "type" in filters) {
				setCurrentFilters((prev) => {
					const updated = { ...prev };
					delete updated.type;
					return updated;
				});
			}

			try {
				console.log({ mergedFilters });
				const data = await fetchNotifications(mergedFilters);

				setNotifications((prevNotifications) =>
					mergedFilters.page === 1
						? data.notifications
						: [...prevNotifications, ...data.notifications]
				);

				setUnreadCount(data.unreadCount);
				setHasMore(data.notifications.length === 10);
			} catch (err: any) {
				setError(err);
				console.error("Error fetching notifications:", err);
			} finally {
				setIsLoading(false);
			}
		},
		[currentFilters, currentPage, user]
	);

	const fetchMoreNotifications = async (
		filters: NotificationFilterDto = {}
	) => {
		if (!hasMore || isLoading) return;
		const nextPage = currentPage + 1;
		setCurrentPage(nextPage);
		await fetchUserNotifications({
			...currentFilters,
			...filters,
			page: nextPage,
		});
	};

	const markNotificationAsRead = async (id: string) => {
		try {
			const success = await markAsRead([id]);
			if (success) {
				setNotifications((prev) =>
					prev.map((notif) =>
						notif.id === id ? { ...notif, isRead: true } : notif
					)
				);
				setUnreadCount((prev) => Math.max(0, prev - 1));
			}
		} catch (err) {
			console.error("Error marking notification as read:", err);
		}
	};

	const markAllNotificationsAsRead = async () => {
		try {
			const success = await markAllAsRead();
			if (success) {
				setNotifications((prev) =>
					prev.map((notif) => ({ ...notif, isRead: true }))
				);
				setUnreadCount(0);
			}
		} catch (err) {
			console.error("Error marking all notifications as read:", err);
		}
	};

	const deleteUserNotification = async (id: string) => {
		try {
			const success = await deleteNotification(id);
			if (success) {
				setNotifications((prev) => prev.filter((notif) => notif.id !== id));
				if (notifications.find((n) => n.id === id)?.isRead === false) {
					setUnreadCount((prev) => Math.max(0, prev - 1));
				}
			}
		} catch (err) {
			console.error("Error deleting notification:", err);
		}
	};

	const refetchNotifications = useCallback(
		async (filters: NotificationFilterDto = {}) => {
			setCurrentPage(1);
			await fetchUserNotifications({ ...filters, page: 1 });
		},
		[fetchUserNotifications]
	);

	useEffect(() => {
		if (user) {
			fetchUserNotifications();
		}
	}, [user, fetchUserNotifications]);

	useEffect(() => {
		if (!user) return;

		const fetchUnreadCount = async () => {
			try {
				const count = await getUnreadCount();
				if (count > unreadCount) {
					refetchNotifications();
				} else {
					setUnreadCount(count);
				}
			} catch (err) {
				console.error("Error polling notifications:", err);
			}
		};

		const intervalId = setInterval(fetchUnreadCount, 60000);
		return () => clearInterval(intervalId);
	}, [user, unreadCount, refetchNotifications]);

	const value = {
		notifications,
		unreadCount,
		isLoading,
		error,
		fetchMoreNotifications,
		markNotificationAsRead,
		markAllNotificationsAsRead,
		deleteUserNotification,
		refetchNotifications,
	};

	return (
		<NotificationsContext.Provider value={value}>
			{children}
		</NotificationsContext.Provider>
	);
}

export function useNotifications() {
	const context = useContext(NotificationsContext);
	if (context === undefined) {
		throw new Error(
			"useNotifications must be used within a NotificationsProvider"
		);
	}
	return context;
}

File: src/context/user-mode.provider.tsx
================
"use client";
import React, {
	createContext,
	useState,
	useEffect,
	useContext,
	ReactNode,
} from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useAuth } from "./auth.provider";
import { setCookie, getCookie } from "cookies-next";

type UserMode = "creator" | "user";

interface UserModeContextType {
	mode: UserMode;
	setMode: (mode: UserMode) => void;
}

const UserModeContext = createContext<UserModeContextType | undefined>(
	undefined
);

export const UserModeProvider: React.FC<{ children: ReactNode }> = ({
	children,
}) => {
	const [mode, setModeState] = useState<UserMode>("user");
	const [isInitialized, setIsInitialized] = useState(false);
	const router = useRouter();
	const { user, isLoadingUser } = useAuth();

	const setMode = (newMode: UserMode) => {
		setModeState(newMode);
		if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
			localStorage.setItem("userMode", newMode);
			setCookie("userMode", newMode, {
				path: "/",
				maxAge: 30 * 24 * 60 * 60,
				sameSite: "lax",
			});
		}
	};

	useEffect(() => {
		if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
			const cookieMode = getCookie("userMode") as UserMode | undefined;
			const savedMode = localStorage.getItem("userMode") as UserMode;

			let newMode: UserMode = "user";

			if (cookieMode === "creator" || cookieMode === "user") {
				newMode = cookieMode;
			} else if (savedMode === "creator" || savedMode === "user") {
				newMode = savedMode;
			}

			setModeState(newMode);

			localStorage.setItem("userMode", newMode);
			setCookie("userMode", newMode, {
				path: "/",
				maxAge: 30 * 24 * 60 * 60,
				sameSite: "lax",
			});

			setIsInitialized(true);
		}
	}, []);

	useEffect(() => {
		if (isInitialized && !isLoadingUser && user) {
			const currentPath = window.location.pathname;

			if (currentPath === "/") {
				if (mode === "creator") {
					router.push("/profile");
				} else {
					router.push("/explore");
				}
			}
		}
	}, [isInitialized, isLoadingUser, user, mode, router]);

	return (
		<UserModeContext.Provider value={{ mode, setMode }}>
			{children}
		</UserModeContext.Provider>
	);
};

export const useUserMode = (): UserModeContextType => {
	const context = useContext(UserModeContext);
	if (context === undefined) {
		throw new Error("useUserMode must be used within a UserModeProvider");
	}
	return context;
};

File: src/page-components/profile/community-page/direct-messagees-filter-popover.tsx
================
import React from "react";
import {
	PopoverBody,
	PopoverContent,
	PopoverHeader,
	PopoverRoot,
	PopoverTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/popover";
import { Flex, Stack, Text } from "@chakra-ui/react";
import { Icon } from "@iconify/react/dist/iconify.js";

const DirectMessagesFilterPopover: React.FC = () => {
	return (
		<PopoverRoot>
			<PopoverTrigger>
				<Flex
					_hover={{
						bg: "gray.100",
					}}
					w={"40px"}
					h={"40px"}
					borderRadius={"999px"}
					justifyContent={"center"}
					alignItems={"center"}
					cursor={"pointer"}
				>
					<Icon icon={"mynaui:filter"} />
				</Flex>
			</PopoverTrigger>
			<PopoverContent w={"200px"}>
				<PopoverHeader>FILTER</PopoverHeader>
				<PopoverBody>
					<Stack>
						<Flex justifyContent={"space-between"} alignItems={"center"}>
							<Text fontWeight={500}>All</Text>
							<Icon width={"24px"} icon={"mynaui:check"} />
						</Flex>

						<Flex justifyContent={"space-between"} alignItems={"center"}>
							<Text fontWeight={500}>Unread</Text>
						</Flex>
					</Stack>
				</PopoverBody>
			</PopoverContent>
		</PopoverRoot>
	);
};

export default DirectMessagesFilterPopover;

================
File: src/page-components/profile/community-page/chat-input.tsx
================
"use client";
import React, { useState, useRef } from "react";
import { Box, IconButton, Flex, Textarea } from "@chakra-ui/react";
import { toaster } from "@/components/ui/toaster";
import { Icon } from "@iconify/react/dist/iconify.js";
import ButtonWithIcon from "@/components/ui/button-with-icon";

interface ChatInputProps {
  onSendMessage: (content: string, attachment?: File) => Promise<void>;
}

const ChatInput: React.FC<ChatInputProps> = ({ onSendMessage }) => {
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    if (!message.trim() && !fileInputRef.current?.files?.length) return;

    try {
      setIsSubmitting(true);
      const attachment = fileInputRef.current?.files?.[0];
      await onSendMessage(message.trim(), attachment);
      setMessage("");
      if (fileInputRef.current) {
        fileInputRef.current.value = "";
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);
      toaster.create({
        title: "Error sending message",
        description: "Please try again",
        type: "error",
        duration: 3000,
      });
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleKeyPress = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (e.key === "Enter" && !e.shiftKey) {
      e.preventDefault();
      handleSubmit();
    }
  };

  return (
    <Box>
      <Flex gap={2}>
        <input
          type="file"
          ref={fileInputRef}
          style={{ display: "none" }}
          onChange={() => {}} // Handle file change if needed
          accept="image/*,.pdf,.doc,.docx"
        />
        <IconButton
          aria-label="Attach file"
          variant="ghost"
          onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
        >
          {/* <AttachmentIcon /> */}
          <Icon icon={"qlementine-icons:attachement-16"} />
        </IconButton>
        <IconButton
          aria-label="Add emoji"
          // icon={<SmileIcon />}
          variant="ghost"
          // Implement emoji picker
          onClick={() => {}}
        >
          <Icon icon={"tdesign:smile-filled"} />
        </IconButton>
        <Textarea
          value={message}
          onChange={(e) => setMessage(e.target.value)}
          onKeyPress={handleKeyPress}
          placeholder="Type a message..."
          resize="none"
          rows={1}
          flex={1}
        />
        <ButtonWithIcon
          colorScheme="blue"
          loading={isSubmitting}
          onClick={handleSubmit}
          // leftIcon={<SendIcon />}
          icon="material-symbols-light:send-rounded"
        >
          Send
        </ButtonWithIcon>
      </Flex>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default ChatInput;

File: src/page-components/profile/community-page/chat-message.tsx

"use client";

import React from "react";
import { Box, Flex, Text, Link, Image } from "@chakra-ui/react";
import { format } from "date-fns";
import { Avatar } from "@/components/ui/avatar";

interface MessageAttachment {
  url: string;
  fileName: string;
  fileType: string;
  fileSize: number;
}

interface Message {
  id: string;
  content: string;
  sender: {
    id: string;
    displayName: string;
    profilePicture?: string;
  };
  attachments?: MessageAttachment[];
  createdAt: string;
}

interface ChatMessageProps {
  message: Message;
  isOwnMessage: boolean;
}

const ChatMessage: React.FC<ChatMessageProps> = ({ message, isOwnMessage }) => {
  const isImage = (fileType: string) => fileType.startsWith("image/");

  return (
    <Flex
      justify={isOwnMessage ? "flex-end" : "flex-start"}
      align="flex-start"
      gap={2}
    >
      {!isOwnMessage && (
        <Avatar
          size="sm"
          src={message.sender.profilePicture}
          name={message.sender.displayName}
        />
      )}
      <Box
        maxW="70%"
        bg={isOwnMessage ? "blue.500" : "gray.100"}
        color={isOwnMessage ? "white" : "black"}
        p={3}
        borderRadius="lg"
      >
        {!isOwnMessage && (
          <Text fontSize="sm" fontWeight="bold" mb={1}>
            {message.sender.displayName}
          </Text>
        )}
        <Text>{message.content}</Text>

        {message.attachments?.map((attachment, index) => (
          <Box key={index} mt={2}>
            {isImage(attachment.fileType) ? (
              <Image
                src={attachment.url}
                alt={attachment.fileName}
                maxH="200px"
                borderRadius="md"
                cursor="pointer"
                onClick={() => window.open(attachment.url, "_blank")}
              />
            ) : (
              <Link href={attachment.url} color="blue.400">
                📎 {attachment.fileName}
              </Link>
            )}
          </Box>
        ))}

        <Text
          fontSize="xs"
          color={isOwnMessage ? "whiteAlpha.700" : "gray.500"}
          mt={1}
        >
          {format(new Date(message.createdAt), "h:mm a")}
        </Text>
      </Box>
    </Flex>
  );
};

export default ChatMessage;

"use client";

import { Box, Stack, Text, Flex } from "@chakra-ui/react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import { format } from "date-fns";
import { Avatar } from "@/components/ui/avatar";

interface Chat {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  lastMessage?: {
    content: string;
    sender: string;
    timestamp: string;
  };
  creator: {
    id: string;
    displayName: string;
    profilePicture?: string;
  };
  unreadCount?: number;
}

interface ChatsListProps {
  chats: Chat[];
}

const ChatsList: React.FC<ChatsListProps> = ({ chats }) => {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const isUserMode = pathname?.startsWith("/user");
  const baseUrl = isUserMode
    ? "/user/messages/chat"
    : "/profile/community/chat";

  return (
    <Stack gap={2}>
      {chats.map((chat) => (
        <Link key={chat.id} href={`${baseUrl}/${chat.id}`}>
          <Box
            p={3}
            borderRadius="md"
            _hover={{ bg: "gray.50" }}
            cursor="pointer"
          >
            <Flex justify="space-between" align="flex-start" mb={1}>
              <Flex align="center" gap={2}>
                <Avatar
                  size="sm"
                  name={chat.title}
                  src={chat.creator.profilePicture}
                />
                <Box>
                  <Text fontWeight="medium">{chat.title}</Text>
                  <Text fontSize="sm" color="gray.600">
                    {chat.lastMessage?.content || "No messages yet"}
                  </Text>
                </Box>
              </Flex>
              <Box textAlign="right">
                <Text fontSize="xs" color="gray.500">
                  {chat.lastMessage?.timestamp
                    ? format(new Date(chat.lastMessage.timestamp), "h:mm a")
                    : ""}
                </Text>
                {chat.unreadCount ? (
                  <Box
                    bg="blue.500"
                    color="white"
                    borderRadius="full"
                    px={2}
                    py={0.5}
                    fontSize="xs"
                    mt={1}
                  >
                    {chat.unreadCount}
                  </Box>
                ) : null}
              </Box>
            </Flex>
          </Box>
        </Link>
      ))}
      {chats.length === 0 && (
        <Text textAlign="center" color="gray.500" py={4}>
          No chats available
        </Text>
      )}
    </Stack>
  );
};

export default ChatsList;

"use client";

import { Box, Stack, Text, Flex } from "@chakra-ui/react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import { format } from "date-fns";
import { Avatar } from "@/components/ui/avatar";

interface Chat {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  lastMessage?: {
    content: string;
    sender: string;
    timestamp: string;
  };
  participants: Array<{
    id: string;
    displayName: string;
    profilePicture?: string;
    isCreator: boolean;
  }>;
  creator: {
    id: string;
    displayName: string;
    profilePicture?: string;
  };
  unreadCount?: number;
}

interface DirectMessagesListProps {
  chats: Chat[];
}

const DirectMessagesList: React.FC<DirectMessagesListProps> = ({ chats }) => {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const isUserMode = pathname?.startsWith("/user");
  const baseUrl = isUserMode
    ? "/user/messages/direct-messages"
    : "/profile/community/direct-messages";

  return (
    <Stack gap={2}>
      {chats.map((chat) => {
        const otherParticipant = chat.participants.find(
          (p) => p.id !== chat.creator.id
        );

        return (
          <Link key={chat.id} href={`${baseUrl}/${chat.id}`}>
            <Box
              p={3}
              borderRadius="md"
              _hover={{ bg: "gray.50" }}
              cursor="pointer"
            >
              <Flex justify="space-between" align="flex-start" mb={1}>
                <Flex align="center" gap={2}>
                  <Avatar
                    size="sm"
                    name={otherParticipant?.displayName}
                    src={otherParticipant?.profilePicture}
                  />
                  <Box>
                    <Text fontWeight="medium">
                      {otherParticipant?.displayName}
                    </Text>
                    <Text fontSize="sm" color="gray.600">
                      {chat.lastMessage?.content || "No messages yet"}
                    </Text>
                  </Box>
                </Flex>
                <Box textAlign="right">
                  <Text fontSize="xs" color="gray.500">
                    {chat.lastMessage?.timestamp
                      ? format(new Date(chat.lastMessage.timestamp), "h:mm a")
                      : ""}
                  </Text>
                  {chat.unreadCount ? (
                    <Box
                      bg="blue.500"
                      color="white"
                      borderRadius="full"
                      px={2}
                      py={0.5}
                      fontSize="xs"
                      mt={1}
                    >
                      {chat.unreadCount}
                    </Box>
                  ) : null}
                </Box>
              </Flex>
            </Box>
          </Link>
        );
      })}
      {chats.length === 0 && (
        <Text textAlign="center" color="gray.500" py={4}>
          No direct messages
        </Text>
      )}
    </Stack>
  );
};

export default DirectMessagesList;

"use client";

import React from "react";
import { Sidebar } from "./sidebar";
import { ChatProvider } from "@/context/chat.provider";
import ChatMessages from "./chat-messages";
import DirectMessages from "./direct-messages";
import { useAuth } from "@/context/auth.provider";
import { Box } from "@chakra-ui/react";

const CommunityPage: React.FC<{
  page: "chat" | "direct-messages";
  mode?: "user" | "creator";
}> = ({ page, mode: explicitMode }) => {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const mode = explicitMode || (user?.isCreator ? "creator" : "user");

  return (
    <ChatProvider>
      <Box>
        <Sidebar page={page} mode={mode} />
        {page === "chat" ? (
          <ChatMessages mode={mode} />
        ) : (
          <DirectMessages mode={mode} />
        )}
      </Box>
    </ChatProvider>
  );
};

================
File: src/page-components/profile/community-page/sidebar.tsx
================
"use client";

import { Box, HStack, Text, Badge } from "@chakra-ui/react";
import { FC, useEffect } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import ChatsList from "./chats-list";
import DirectMessagesList from "./direct-messages-list";
import DirectMessagesSearch from "./direct-messages-search";
import { useChat } from "@/context/chat.provider";
import { useAuth } from "@/context/auth.provider";
import { Chat } from "@/lib/backend-services/chat-service";

interface SidebarProps {
  page: "chat" | "direct-messages";
  mode: "user" | "creator";
}

export const Sidebar: FC<SidebarProps> = ({ page, mode }) => {
  const { groupChats, directChats, loadChats } = useChat();
  const { user } = useAuth();

  useEffect(() => {
    loadChats();
  }, [loadChats]);

  const filterCondition = (chat: Chat) => {
    if (!user || !chat.creator) return false;
    return mode === "creator"
      ? chat.creator.id === user._id
      : chat.creator.id !== user._id;
  };

  const filteredGroupChats = groupChats.filter(filterCondition);
  const filteredDirectChats = directChats.filter(filterCondition);

  const groupUnreadCount = filteredGroupChats.reduce(
    (sum, chat) => sum + chat.unreadCount,
    0
  );
  const directUnreadCount = filteredDirectChats.reduce(
    (sum, chat) => sum + chat.unreadCount,
    0
  );

  const chatHref =
    mode === "creator" ? "/profile/community/chat" : "/user/messages/chat";
  const dmHref =
    mode === "creator"
      ? "/profile/community/direct-messages"
      : "/user/messages/direct-messages";

  return (
    <Box
      w="300px"
      bg={"white"}
      position={"fixed"}
      top={0}
      left={{ base: 0, lg: "300px" }}
      minH={"100vh"}
      borderRightWidth="1px"
      p={4}
      display={{ base: "none", md: "block" }}
    >
      <Text fontSize="2xl" fontWeight="bold" mb={4}>
        {mode === "creator" ? "Community" : "Messages"}
      </Text>
      <HStack
        css={{
          "& a": {
            px: 4,
            py: 2,
            borderRadius: "8px",
            fontSize: "sm",
            fontWeight: 600,
            position: "relative",
            '&[data-active="true"]': {
              bg: "gray.200",
            },
            "&:hover": {
              bg: "gray.100",
            },
          },
        }}
        gap={4}
        mb={4}
      >
        <Link data-active={page === "chat"} href={chatHref}>
          Chats
          {groupUnreadCount > 0 && (
            <Badge
              position="absolute"
              top="-5px"
              right="-5px"
              colorPalette="blue"
              borderRadius="full"
            >
              {groupUnreadCount}
            </Badge>
          )}
        </Link>
        <Link data-active={page === "direct-messages"} href={dmHref}>
          Direct Messages
          {directUnreadCount > 0 && (
            <Badge
              position="absolute"
              top="-5px"
              right="-5px"
              colorPalette="blue"
              borderRadius="full"
            >
              {directUnreadCount}
            </Badge>
          )}
        </Link>
      </HStack>
      {page === "direct-messages" && <DirectMessagesSearch />}
      {page === "chat" && <ChatsList chats={filteredGroupChats} />}
      {page === "direct-messages" && (
        <DirectMessagesList chats={filteredDirectChats} />
      )}
    </Box>
  );
};

export default Sidebar;

================
File: src/context/chat.provider.tsx
================
"use client";

import React, {
  createContext,
  useCallback,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useRef,
} from "react";
import chatService, {
  Chat,
  ChatMessage,
} from "@/lib/backend-services/chat-service";
import { useAuth } from "./auth.provider";

interface ChatState {
  directChats: Chat[];
  groupChats: Chat[];
  currentChat: Chat | null;
  messages: ChatMessage[];
  hasMoreMessages: boolean;
  isLoading: boolean;
  isSending: boolean;
  typingUsers: Record<string, Set<string>>;
  unreadCount: number;
}

interface ChatContextType extends ChatState {
  connectToChat: () => Promise<void>;
  disconnectFromChat: () => void;
  loadChats: () => Promise<void>;
  loadChat: (chatId: string) => Promise<void>;
  sendMessage: (content: string, attachment?: File) => Promise<void>;
  loadMoreMessages: () => Promise<void>;
  markMessagesAsRead: () => Promise<void>;
  setTyping: (isTyping: boolean) => void;
  createGroupChat: (data: {
    title: string;
    description?: string;
    accessType: "all" | "paid" | "select";
    accessTiers?: string[];
  }) => Promise<Chat>;
  createDirectChat: (participantId: string) => Promise<Chat>;
}

const ChatContext = createContext<ChatContextType | undefined>(undefined);

export function ChatProvider({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [connected, setConnected] = React.useState(false);
  const [state, setState] = React.useState<ChatState>({
    directChats: [],
    groupChats: [],
    currentChat: null,
    messages: [],
    hasMoreMessages: false,
    isLoading: false,
    isSending: false,
    typingUsers: {},
    unreadCount: 0,
  });

  // Use refs to store mutable state that we don't want to trigger re-renders
  const stateRef = useRef(state);
  stateRef.current = state;

  const updateState = (newState: Partial<ChatState>) => {
    console.log(
      "[ChatProvider] updateState called. New partial state:",
      newState
    );
    setState((prev) => {
      const nextState = { ...prev, ...newState };
      console.log(
        "[ChatProvider] State updated. Previous:",
        prev,
        "Next:",
        nextState
      );
      stateRef.current = nextState; // Update ref immediately after state update
      return nextState;
    });
  };

  const loadChats = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      updateState({ isLoading: true });
      const { directChats, groupChats } = await chatService.getUserChats();
      const chronologicallyOrderedGroupChats = groupChats.reverse();
      updateState({
        directChats,
        groupChats: chronologicallyOrderedGroupChats,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error loading chats:", error);
    } finally {
      updateState({ isLoading: false });
    }
  }, []);

  const connectToChat = useCallback(async () => {
    console.log("[ChatProvider] connectToChat called (now only connects).");
    if (!user || chatService.isConnected() || chatService.isConnecting()) {
      console.log(
        "[ChatProvider] connectToChat skipped (no user / already connected / already connecting)."
      );
      return;
    }
    try {
      await chatService.connect();
      console.log(
        "[ChatProvider] chatService.connect() promise resolved (connection pending event)..."
      );
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("[ChatProvider] connectToChat initiation failed:", error);
      setConnected(false);
    }
  }, [user]);

  const disconnectFromChat = useCallback(() => {
    console.log("[ChatProvider] disconnectFromChat called.");
    chatService.disconnect();
    setConnected(false);
  }, []);

  const loadChat = useCallback(async (chatId: string) => {
    try {
      updateState({ isLoading: true });
      const chat = await chatService.getChat(chatId);
      updateState({ currentChat: chat });

      const { messages, hasMore } = await chatService.getMessages(chatId);
      updateState({ messages, hasMoreMessages: hasMore });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(`Error loading chat ${chatId}:`, error);
    } finally {
      updateState({ isLoading: false });
    }
  }, []);

  const sendMessage = useCallback(
    async (content: string, attachment?: File) => {
      const currentState = stateRef.current;
      if (!currentState.currentChat) return;

      try {
        updateState({ isSending: true });
        const message = await chatService.sendMessage(
          currentState.currentChat.id,
          content,
          attachment
        );
        updateState({
          messages: [...currentState.messages, message],
        });
      } catch (error) {
        console.error("Error sending message:", error);
      } finally {
        updateState({ isSending: false });
      }
    },
    []
  );

  const loadMoreMessages = useCallback(async () => {
    const currentState = stateRef.current;
    if (
      !currentState.currentChat ||
      !currentState.hasMoreMessages ||
      currentState.isLoading
    )
      return;

    try {
      updateState({ isLoading: true });
      const firstMessageId = currentState.messages[0]?.id;
      const { messages, hasMore } = await chatService.getMessages(
        currentState.currentChat.id,
        { before: firstMessageId }
      );
      updateState({
        messages: [...currentState.messages, ...messages],
        hasMoreMessages: hasMore,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error loading more messages:", error);
    } finally {
      updateState({ isLoading: false });
    }
  }, []);

  const markMessagesAsRead = useCallback(async () => {
    const currentState = stateRef.current;
    if (!currentState.currentChat || currentState.messages.length === 0) return;
    console.log(
      `[ChatProvider] markMessagesAsRead called for chat: ${currentState.currentChat.id}`
    );

    try {
      const lastMessageId =
        currentState.messages[currentState.messages.length - 1].id;
      await chatService.markMessagesAsRead(
        currentState.currentChat.id,
        lastMessageId
      );

      updateState({
        directChats: currentState.directChats.map((chat) =>
          chat.id === currentState.currentChat?.id
            ? { ...chat, unreadCount: 0 }
            : chat
        ),
        groupChats: currentState.groupChats.map((chat) =>
          chat.id === currentState.currentChat?.id
            ? { ...chat, unreadCount: 0 }
            : chat
        ),
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error marking messages as read:", error);
    }
  }, []);

  const setTyping = useCallback((isTyping: boolean) => {
    const currentState = stateRef.current;
    if (!currentState.currentChat) return;
    chatService.sendTypingIndicator(currentState.currentChat.id, isTyping);
  }, []);

  const createGroupChat = useCallback(
    async (data: {
      title: string;
      description?: string;
      accessType: "all" | "paid" | "select";
      accessTiers?: string[];
    }) => {
      return await chatService.createGroupChat(data);
    },
    []
  );

  const createDirectChat = useCallback(async (participantId: string) => {
    return await chatService.createDirectChat(participantId);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    console.log("[ChatProvider] Main useEffect running. Deps:", {
      user: !!user,
    });

    if (!user) {
      console.log("[ChatProvider] No user, disconnecting if connected.");
      if (chatService.isConnected()) {
        disconnectFromChat();
      }
      setState({
        directChats: [],
        groupChats: [],
        currentChat: null,
        messages: [],
        hasMoreMessages: false,
        isLoading: false,
        isSending: false,
        typingUsers: {},
        unreadCount: 0,
      });
      return;
    }

    const setupListeners = () => {
      console.log(
        "[ChatProvider] setupListeners() defining handlers and attaching listeners."
      );

      const handleConnected = (data: { userId: string }) => {
        console.log(
          "[ChatProvider] Listener triggered: 'connected'. Setting connected state to true.",
          data
        );
        setConnected(true);
        loadChats();
        chatService.getUnreadCount().then((count) => {
          console.log("[ChatProvider] Received initial unread count:", count);
          updateState({ unreadCount: count });
        });
        console.log(
          "[ChatProvider] Initial chats and unread count loading initiated after connection."
        );
      };

      const handleDisconnect = () => {
        console.warn(
          "[ChatProvider] Listener triggered: 'disconnect'. Setting connected state to false."
        );
        setConnected(false);
      };

      const handleConnectError = (error: Error) => {
        console.error(
          "[ChatProvider] Listener triggered: 'connect_error'. Setting connected state to false.",
          error
        );
        setConnected(false);
      };

      const handleNewMessage = (data: {
        chatId: string;
        message: ChatMessage;
      }) => {
        console.log(
          "[ChatProvider] Listener triggered: 'new_message'. Data:",
          data
        );
        const currentState = stateRef.current;
        console.log("[ChatProvider] handleNewMessage - Current state:", {
          currentChatId: currentState.currentChat?.id,
          messageChatId: data.chatId,
        });

        if (currentState.currentChat?.id === data.chatId) {
          console.log(
            "[ChatProvider] handleNewMessage - Updating messages for current chat."
          );
          updateState({
            messages: [...currentState.messages, data.message],
          });
          console.log(
            "[ChatProvider] handleNewMessage - Calling markMessagesAsRead after adding message."
          );
          markMessagesAsRead();
        }

        const updateChatList = (chats: Chat[]): Chat[] =>
          chats.map((chat) =>
            chat.id === data.chatId
              ? {
                  ...chat,
                  lastMessage: {
                    content: data.message.content,
                    sender: data.message.sender.displayName,
                    timestamp: data.message.createdAt,
                  },
                  unreadCount:
                    currentState.currentChat?.id === data.chatId
                      ? chat.unreadCount
                      : (chat.unreadCount || 0) + 1,
                }
              : chat
          );

        console.log("[ChatProvider] handleNewMessage - Updating chat lists.");
        const newDirectChats = updateChatList(currentState.directChats);
        const newGroupChats = updateChatList(currentState.groupChats);
        const increment = currentState.currentChat?.id === data.chatId ? 0 : 1;
        updateState({
          directChats: newDirectChats,
          groupChats: newGroupChats,
          unreadCount: currentState.unreadCount + increment,
        });
      };

      const handleMessageRead = (data: {
        chatId: string;
        userId: string;
        lastReadMessageId: string;
      }) => {
        console.log(
          "[ChatProvider] Listener triggered: 'message_read'. Data:",
          data
        );
        const currentState = stateRef.current;
        if (currentState.currentChat?.id !== data.chatId) return;

        console.log(
          "[ChatProvider] handleMessageRead - Updating messages readBy status."
        );
        updateState({
          messages: currentState.messages.map((msg) => {
            if (
              msg.id <= data.lastReadMessageId &&
              !msg.readBy.includes(data.userId)
            ) {
              return { ...msg, readBy: [...msg.readBy, data.userId] };
            }
            return msg;
          }),
        });
      };

      const handleUserTyping = (data: {
        chatId: string;
        userId: string;
        isTyping: boolean;
      }) => {
        console.log(
          "[ChatProvider] Listener triggered: 'user_typing'. Data:",
          data
        );
        const currentState = stateRef.current;
        if (
          currentState.currentChat?.id !== data.chatId ||
          data.userId === user?._id
        )
          return;

        console.log(
          "[ChatProvider] handleUserTyping - Updating typingUsers state."
        );

        const currentTypers =
          currentState.typingUsers[data.chatId] || new Set<string>();
        const nextTypers = new Set(currentTypers);
        if (data.isTyping) {
          nextTypers.add(data.userId);
        } else {
          nextTypers.delete(data.userId);
        }

        const nextTypingUsersState = { ...currentState.typingUsers };

        if (nextTypers.size === 0) {
          delete nextTypingUsersState[data.chatId];
        } else {
          nextTypingUsersState[data.chatId] = nextTypers;
        }

        updateState({ typingUsers: nextTypingUsersState });

        if (data.isTyping) {
          setTimeout(() => {
            const latestState = stateRef.current;
            if (latestState.typingUsers[data.chatId]?.has(data.userId)) {
              const latestTyping = { ...latestState.typingUsers };
              const chatTypers = new Set(latestTyping[data.chatId]);

              if (chatTypers.delete(data.userId)) {
                if (chatTypers.size === 0) {
                  delete latestTyping[data.chatId];
                } else {
                  latestTyping[data.chatId] = chatTypers;
                }
                console.log(
                  `[ChatProvider] handleUserTyping - Auto-cleared typing indicator for user ${data.userId} in chat ${data.chatId}`
                );
                updateState({ typingUsers: latestTyping });
              }
            }
          }, 3000);
        }
      };

      const handleUnreadCountUpdate = (data: { count: number }) => {
        console.log(
          "[ChatProvider] Listener triggered: 'unread_count_update'. Data:",
          data
        );
        updateState({ unreadCount: data.count });
      };

      const unsubscribers = [
        chatService.on("connected", handleConnected),
        chatService.on("disconnect", handleDisconnect),
        chatService.on("connect_error", handleConnectError),
        chatService.on("new_message", handleNewMessage),
        chatService.on("message_read", handleMessageRead),
        chatService.on("user_typing", handleUserTyping),
        chatService.on("unread_count_update", handleUnreadCountUpdate),
      ];
      console.log("[ChatProvider] Listeners attached via chatService.on.");

      return () => {
        console.log(
          "[ChatProvider] Cleanup function: Unsubscribing all listeners."
        );
        unsubscribers.forEach((unsub) => unsub());
      };
    };

    console.log("[ChatProvider] Setting up listeners...");
    const cleanupListeners = setupListeners();

    if (user && !chatService.isConnected() && !chatService.isConnecting()) {
      console.log(
        "[ChatProvider] User found, service not connected/connecting. Calling connectToChat..."
      );
      connectToChat();
    } else if (chatService.isConnected()) {
      console.log("[ChatProvider] Service already connected on effect run.");
      if (!connected) {
        console.log(
          "[ChatProvider] Syncing provider connected state to true and loading initial data."
        );
        setConnected(true);
        loadChats();
        chatService
          .getUnreadCount()
          .then((count) => updateState({ unreadCount: count }));
      }
    } else if (chatService.isConnecting()) {
      console.log(
        "[ChatProvider] Service is currently connecting. Waiting for connected/error event."
      );
    }

    return () => {
      console.log("[ChatProvider] Main useEffect cleanup running.");
      cleanupListeners();
    };
  }, [user, connectToChat, disconnectFromChat, loadChats]);

  const contextValue: ChatContextType = {
    ...state,
    connectToChat,
    disconnectFromChat,
    loadChats,
    loadChat,
    sendMessage,
    loadMoreMessages,
    markMessagesAsRead,
    setTyping,
    createGroupChat,
    createDirectChat,
  };

  return (
    <ChatContext.Provider value={contextValue}>{children}</ChatContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useChat() {
  const context = useContext(ChatContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error("useChat must be used within a ChatProvider");
  }
  return context;
}

"use client";

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react"; // Added useState
import { Box, Flex, Stack, Text, Spinner } from "@chakra-ui/react";
import { useChat } from "@/context/chat.provider"; // Use unified provider
import ChatMessage from "./chat-message";
import ChatInput from "./chat-input";
import { useParams } from "next/navigation";
// --- START FIX: Import useAuth ---
import { useAuth } from "@/context/auth.provider"; // Adjust path if needed
// --- END FIX ---

interface ChatMessagesProps {
  mode: "user" | "creator"; // Keep mode prop if still needed elsewhere
}

// Replace the existing ChatMessages function
const ChatMessages: React.FC<ChatMessagesProps> = () => {
  // Removed mode prop if not used directly here
  const { chatId } = useParams<{ chatId: string }>();
  // Add log here, after chatId is declared
  console.log("Rendering ChatMessages component. Current chat ID:", chatId);

  const {
    loadChat,
    currentChat,
    messages,
    sendMessage,
    loadMoreMessages,
    hasMoreMessages,
    isLoading,
  } = useChat();

  // --- START FIX: Get logged-in user ---
  const { user } = useAuth(); // Get the authenticated user
  // --- END FIX ---

  const messagesEndRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const prevMessagesLengthRef = useRef<number>(0);

  // --- START FIX: Improved Scrolling Logic ---
  const chatContainerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null); // Add ref to the scrollable Stack
  const [isNearBottom, setIsNearBottom] = useState(true); // Track if user is near the bottom
  const [shouldScrollToBottom, setShouldScrollToBottom] = useState(true); // Flag to control initial scroll

  // Update scroll state when user scrolls
  useEffect(() => {
    const container = chatContainerRef.current;
    if (!container) return;

    const handleScroll = () => {
      const { scrollTop, scrollHeight, clientHeight } = container;
      // Consider user near bottom if they are within, say, 200px of it
      const nearBottom = scrollHeight - scrollTop - clientHeight < 200;
      setIsNearBottom(nearBottom);
      // If user scrolls up, don't automatically scroll to bottom on new messages
      if (scrollTop < scrollHeight - clientHeight - 200) {
        setShouldScrollToBottom(false);
      }
    };

    container.addEventListener("scroll", handleScroll);
    // Initial check
    handleScroll();

    return () => container.removeEventListener("scroll", handleScroll);
  }, []); // Run only once on mount

  // Effect to load chat data
  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;
    if (chatId && isMounted) {
      setShouldScrollToBottom(true); // Reset scroll flag when loading a new chat
      loadChat(chatId as string);
    }
    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
    };
  }, [chatId, loadChat]); // Depend on chatId and loadChat

  // Effect to handle scrolling based on new messages
  useEffect(() => {
    const container = chatContainerRef.current;
    if (!container || isLoading) return; // Don't scroll while loading

    // Scroll to bottom only if a *new* message arrives (length increased)
    // *and* the user was already near the bottom OR it's the initial load of the chat.
    if (
      messages.length > prevMessagesLengthRef.current &&
      (isNearBottom || shouldScrollToBottom)
    ) {
      // Use setTimeout to ensure DOM has updated after message add
      setTimeout(() => {
        container.scrollTop = container.scrollHeight;
        setShouldScrollToBottom(false); // Don't force scroll again unless chat changes
      }, 50); // Added small delay
    }

    prevMessagesLengthRef.current = messages.length;
  }, [messages, isNearBottom, isLoading, shouldScrollToBottom]); // Add dependencies

  // --- END FIX: Improved Scrolling Logic ---

  if (isLoading && !currentChat) {
    return (
      <Flex
        ml={{ base: 0, lg: "300px" }}
        h="100vh"
        alignItems="center"
        justifyContent="center"
      >
        <Spinner size="xl" color="blue.500" />
      </Flex>
    );
  }

  if (!currentChat) {
    return (
      <Flex
        ml={{ base: 0, lg: "300px" }}
        h="100vh"
        alignItems="center"
        justifyContent="center"
      >
        <Text>Select a chat to start messaging</Text>
      </Flex>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box
      ml={{ base: 0, lg: "300px" }}
      h="100vh"
      display="flex"
      flexDirection="column"
    >
      <Box p={4} borderBottomWidth="1px">
        <Text fontSize="lg" fontWeight="bold">
          {currentChat.title}
        </Text>
        {currentChat.description && (
          <Text fontSize="sm" color="gray.600">
            {currentChat.description}
          </Text>
        )}
      </Box>

      <Stack
        // --- START FIX: Add ref to Stack ---
        ref={chatContainerRef}
        // --- END FIX ---
        flex={1}
        overflowY="auto"
        gap={4}
        p={4}
        css={{
          "&::-webkit-scrollbar": {
            width: "4px",
          },
          "&::-webkit-scrollbar-track": {
            width: "6px",
          },
          "&::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb": {
            background: "gray.200",
            borderRadius: "24px",
          },
        }}
      >
        {hasMoreMessages && (
          <Flex justify="center">
            <Text
              as="button"
              color="blue.500"
              onClick={loadMoreMessages}
              // --- START FIX: Uncomment disabled attribute ---
              // disabled={isLoading}
              // --- END FIX ---
              opacity={isLoading ? 0.5 : 1}
              cursor={isLoading ? "not-allowed" : "pointer"}
            >
              {isLoading ? "Loading..." : "Load more messages"}
            </Text>
          </Flex>
        )}
        {messages.map((message) => (
          <ChatMessage
            key={message.id}
            message={message}
            // --- START FIX: Compare with logged-in user ID ---
            isOwnMessage={message.sender.id === user?._id} // Use logged-in user's ID
            // --- END FIX ---
          />
        ))}
        <div ref={messagesEndRef} />{" "}
        {/* Keep this ref for potential specific scrolls */}
      </Stack>

      <Box p={4} borderTopWidth="1px">
        <ChatInput onSendMessage={sendMessage} />
      </Box>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default ChatMessages;

"use client";

import React, { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { Box, Flex, Stack, Text } from "@chakra-ui/react";
import { useChat } from "@/context/chat.provider";
import ChatMessage from "./chat-message";
import ChatInput from "./chat-input";
import { Avatar } from "@/components/ui/avatar";
import { useAuth } from "@/context/auth.provider"; // Adjust path if needed

interface DirectMessagesProps {
  mode: "user" | "creator"; // Keep mode prop if still needed elsewhere
}

// Replace the existing DirectMessages function
const DirectMessages: React.FC<DirectMessagesProps> = () => {
  // Remove unused variable
  // const { chatId } = useParams<{ chatId: string }>();
  // Use useChat hook
  const {
    // Remove unused variable
    // loadChat,
    currentChat,
    messages,
    sendMessage,
    loadMoreMessages,
    hasMoreMessages,
    isLoading,
  } = useChat();

  // --- START FIX: Get logged-in user ---
  const { user } = useAuth(); // Get the authenticated user
  // --- END FIX ---

  const messagesEndRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const chatContainerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null); // Ref for scroll container

  // Scroll to bottom effect (simpler for direct messages as load more might be less common/different)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (chatContainerRef.current && messages.length > 0) {
      // Use setTimeout to ensure DOM has updated
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (chatContainerRef.current) {
          chatContainerRef.current.scrollTop =
            chatContainerRef.current.scrollHeight;
        }
      }, 50);
    }
  }, [messages]); // Trigger on messages change

  if (!currentChat) {
    return (
      <Flex
        ml={{ base: 0, lg: "300px" }}
        h="100vh"
        alignItems="center"
        justifyContent="center"
      >
        <Text>Select a conversation to start messaging</Text>
      </Flex>
    );
  }

  // Determine the other participant correctly
  // Assuming `user` from useAuth is the logged-in user
  const otherParticipant = currentChat.participants.find(
    (p) => p.id !== user?._id // Compare with logged-in user's ID
  );

  return (

          />
          <Box>
            <Text fontSize="lg" fontWeight="bold">
              {otherParticipant?.displayName || "User"} {/* Fallback name */}
            </Text>
            {/* --- START FIX: Show dynamic role/status if possible --- */}
            <Text fontSize="sm" color="gray.600">
              {/* Example: Check if the other participant is the creator OF THIS CHAT */}
              {otherParticipant?.id === currentChat.creator.id
                ? "Creator"
                : "Member"}
              {/* Or use isCreator flag if available on participant object */}
              {/* {otherParticipant?.isCreator ? "Creator" : "Member"} */}
            </Text>
            {/* --- END FIX --- */}
          </Box>
        </Flex>
      </Box>

      <Stack
        ref={chatContainerRef} // Add ref here
        flex={1}
        overflowY="auto"
        gap={4}
        p={4}
        css={{
          "&::-webkit-scrollbar": {
            width: "4px",
          },
          "&::-webkit-scrollbar-track": {
            width: "6px",
          },
          "&::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb": {
            background: "gray.200",
            borderRadius: "24px",
          },
        }}
      >
        {hasMoreMessages && (
          <Flex justify="center">
            <Text
              as="button"
              color="blue.500"
              onClick={loadMoreMessages}
              // disabled={isLoading} // Ensure disabled is active
              opacity={isLoading ? 0.5 : 1}
              cursor={isLoading ? "not-allowed" : "pointer"}
            >
              {isLoading ? "Loading..." : "Load more messages"}
            </Text>
          </Flex>
        )}
        {messages.map((message) => (
          <ChatMessage
            key={message.id}
            message={message}
            // --- START FIX: Compare with logged-in user ID ---
            isOwnMessage={message.sender.id === user?._id} // Use logged-in user's ID
            // --- END FIX ---
          />
        ))}
        <div ref={messagesEndRef} /> {/* Keep this ref */}
      </Stack>

      <Box p={4} borderTopWidth="1px">
        <ChatInput onSendMessage={sendMessage} />
      </Box>
    </Box>
  );
};

              <Field
                css={{
                  '& [data-state="checked"]': {
                    border: "none",
                  },
                  "& label": {
                    border: "none",
                  },

                label="Select which tier can access this chat"
              >
                <CheckboxGroup defaultValue={["free", "premium"]} w={"full"}>
                  <CheckboxCard
                    border={"none"}
                    w={"full"}
                    label="Free"
                    description="Your free members | 100 members"
                    value="free"
                  />
                  <CheckboxCard
                    border={"none"}

                    label="test"
                    description="Your test members | 10 members"
                    value="test"
                  />
                  <CheckboxCard
                    border={"none"}
                    w={"full"}
                    label="Premium"
                    description="Your premium members | 20 members"
                    value="premium"
                  />
                </CheckboxGroup>
              </Field>
            )}
          </Stack>
        </DialogBody>
        <DialogFooter>
          <Button variant="outline">Cancel</Button>
          <Button>Create</Button>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>

};

File: src/context/posts.provider.tsx

"use client";
import React, {
  createContext,
  useContext,
  useState,
  useCallback,
  ReactNode,
  useMemo,
} from "react";
import {
  PostFilterParams,
  PostsResponse,
  SortBy,
  SortOrder,
  PostItem,
  PaginationInfo,
} from "@/typings/IPost";
import {
  fetchPosts,
  fetchCreatorPosts,
  fetchMyPosts,
  fetchMyDrafts,
} from "@/lib/backend-services/posts-service";
import { CreatorPostsResponse } from "@/lib/backend-services/creator-posts-response";

interface PostsFilterContextType {
  posts: PostItem[];
  creatorPosts: CreatorPostsResponse["posts"];
  pagination: PaginationInfo | null;
  creatorPagination: PaginationInfo | null;
  filters: PostFilterParams;
  isLoading: boolean;
  error: Error | null;
  updateFilters: (newFilters: Partial<PostFilterParams>) => void;
  nextPage: () => void;
  prevPage: () => void;
  resetFilters: () => void;
  refetch: () => Promise<void>;
}

const PostsFilterContext = createContext<PostsFilterContextType | undefined>(
  undefined
);

interface PostsFilterProviderProps {
  children: ReactNode;
  creatorId?: string;
  myPosts?: boolean;
  isDrafts?: boolean;
  initialFilters?: PostFilterParams;
}

export function PostsFilterProvider({
  children,
  creatorId,
  myPosts,
  isDrafts,
  initialFilters,
}: PostsFilterProviderProps) {
  const defaultFilters: PostFilterParams = useMemo(
    () => ({
      page: 1,
      limit: 10,
      sortBy: SortBy.CREATED_AT,
      sortOrder: SortOrder.DESC,
      ...initialFilters,
    }),
    [initialFilters]
  );

  const [filters, setFilters] = useState<PostFilterParams>(defaultFilters);
  const [postsData, setPostsData] = useState<PostsResponse | null>(null);
  const [creatorPostsData, setCreatorPostsData] =
    useState<CreatorPostsResponse | null>(null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<Error | null>(null);

  const fetchPostsData = useCallback(async () => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      let response: PostsResponse;

      if (isDrafts) {
        response = await fetchMyDrafts(filters);
        setPostsData(response);
      } else if (myPosts) {
        response = await fetchMyPosts(filters);
        setPostsData(response);
      } else if (creatorId) {
        const res = await fetchCreatorPosts(creatorId, filters);
        setCreatorPostsData(res);
      } else {
        response = await fetchPosts(filters);
        setPostsData(response);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err);
      console.error("Error fetching posts:", err);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  }, [filters, creatorId, myPosts, isDrafts]);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    fetchPostsData();
  }, [fetchPostsData]);

  const updateFilters = useCallback((newFilters: Partial<PostFilterParams>) => {
    setFilters((prev) => {
      console.log({ prev });
      return {
        ...prev,
        ...newFilters,
        page: newFilters.page !== undefined ? newFilters.page : 1,
      };
    });
  }, []);

  const nextPage = useCallback(() => {
    const pagination = creatorId
      ? creatorPostsData?.pagination
      : postsData?.pagination;

    if (pagination && filters.page && filters.page < pagination.totalPages) {
      setFilters((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        page: (prev.page || 1) + 1,
      }));
    }
  }, [postsData, creatorPostsData, filters.page, creatorId]);

  const prevPage = useCallback(() => {
    if (filters.page && filters.page > 1) {
      setFilters((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        page: (prev.page || 2) - 1,
      }));
    }
  }, [filters.page]);

  const resetFilters = useCallback(() => {
    setFilters(defaultFilters);
  }, [defaultFilters]);

  const value = {
    posts: postsData?.posts || [],
    creatorPosts: creatorPostsData?.posts || [],
    pagination: postsData?.pagination || null,
    creatorPagination: creatorPostsData?.pagination || null,
    filters,
    isLoading,
    error,
    updateFilters,
    nextPage,
    prevPage,
    resetFilters,
    refetch: fetchPostsData,
  };

  return (
    <PostsFilterContext.Provider value={value}>
      {children}
    </PostsFilterContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function usePostsFilter() {
  const context = useContext(PostsFilterContext);
  if (context === undefined) {
    throw new Error("usePostsFilter must be used within a PostsFilterProvider");
  }
  return context;
}

================
File: src/context/auth.provider.tsx

"use client";
import { createContext, ReactNode, useContext } from "react";
import {
  useQuery,
  useMutation,
  UseMutationResult,
  useQueryClient,
} from "@tanstack/react-query";
import api from "@/lib/api";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { jwtDecode } from "jwt-decode";
import { setCookie, deleteCookie } from "cookies-next";
import { CreatorCategory, User } from "@/typings/IUser";
import { getUserMode } from "@/components/SideNav/user-avatar";
import { Gender } from "@/types/auth";

enum GenderPreference {
  MALE = "male",
  FEMALE = "female",
  BOTH = "both",
}

export interface UpdateProfileDto {
  displayName?: string;
  email?: string;
  countryOfResidence?: string;
  gender?: string;
  genderPreference?: GenderPreference;
}

const setAuthToken = (token: string) => {
  localStorage.setItem("token", token);
  setCookie("token", token, {
    path: "/",
    secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === "production",
    sameSite: "lax",
    maxAge: 30 * 24 * 60 * 60, // 30 days
  });
};

const clearAuthToken = () => {
  localStorage.removeItem("token");
  deleteCookie("token", { path: "/" });
};

interface AuthContextType {
  user: User | null | undefined;
  isLoadingUser: boolean;
  checkAuth: () => boolean;
  logout: () => void;
  loginWithEmail: UseMutationResult<AuthResponse, Error, LoginData, unknown>;
  handleGoogleLogin: () => void;
  signup: UseMutationResult<AuthResponse, Error, SignupData, unknown>;
  registerWithEmail: UseMutationResult<
    AuthResponse,
    Error,
    {
      email: string;
      password: string;
      firstName: string;
      lastName: string;
      gender: Gender;
    },
    unknown
  >;
  updateProfile: UseMutationResult<User, Error, UpdateProfileDto, unknown>;
  updateProfilePhoto: UseMutationResult<User, Error, FormData, unknown>;
  onboardCreator: UseMutationResult<
    OnboardingResponse,
    Error,
    CreatorOnboardingData
  >;
}

interface LoginData {
  email: string;
  password: string;
}

interface SignupData {
  email: string;
  password: string;
  firstName?: string;
  lastName?: string;
}

interface AuthResponse {
  user: User;
  token: string;
}

interface CreatorOnboardingData {
  username: string;
  contentVisibleTo: string;
  category: CreatorCategory;
}

interface OnboardingResponse {
  user: User;
  stripeOnboardingUrl: string;
}

const AuthContext = createContext<AuthContextType | undefined>(undefined);

export function AuthProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  const checkAuth = () => {
    try {
      const token = localStorage.getItem("token");
      if (!token) return false;
      const decodedToken = jwtDecode<{ exp?: number }>(token);
      const currentTime = Date.now() / 1000;
      if (decodedToken.exp && decodedToken.exp < currentTime) {
        clearAuthToken();
        return false;
      }
      return true;
    } catch {
      clearAuthToken();
      return false;
    }
  };

  const { data: user, isLoading: isLoadingUser } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["user"],
    queryFn: async () => {
      if (!checkAuth()) return null;
      try {
        const { data } = await api.get<User>("/auth/user");
        return data;
      } catch (error) {
        console.log(error);
        clearAuthToken();
        return null;
      }
    },
  });

  const loginWithEmail = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (data: LoginData) => {
      const response = await api.post<AuthResponse>("/auth/login", data);
      return response.data;
    },
    onSuccess: (data) => {
      setAuthToken(data.token);
      queryClient.setQueryData(["user"], data.user);

      const userMode = getUserMode();
      if (userMode === "creator") {
        router.push("/profile");
      } else {
        router.push("/explore");
      }
    },
  });

  const onboardCreator = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (data: CreatorOnboardingData) => {
      const response = await api.post<OnboardingResponse>(
        "/users/onboard-creator",
        data
      );
      return response.data;
    },
    onSuccess: (data) => {
      queryClient.setQueryData(["user"], data.user);
      localStorage.setItem("userMode", "creator");
    },
  });

  const signup = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (data: SignupData) => {
      const response = await api.post<AuthResponse>("/auth/signup", data);
      return response.data;
    },
    onSuccess: (data) => {
      setAuthToken(data.token);
      queryClient.setQueryData(["user"], data.user);
      router.push("/settings/basic");
    },
  });

  const registerWithEmail = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async ({
      email,
      password,
      firstName,
      lastName,
      gender,
    }: {
      email: string;
      password: string;
      firstName: string;
      lastName: string;
      gender: Gender;
    }) => {
      const { data } = await api.post<AuthResponse>("/auth/register", {
        email,
        password,
        firstName,
        lastName,
        gender,
      });
      if (data.token) {
        setAuthToken(data.token);
      }
      return data;
    },
    onSuccess: (data) => {
      queryClient.setQueryData(["user"], data.user);

      // Redirect based on the user mode in localStorage
      const userMode = getUserMode();
      if (userMode === "creator") {
        router.push("/profile");
      } else {
        router.push("/explore");
      }
    },
    onError: (error) => {
      console.error("Registration error:", error);
    },
  });

  const handleGoogleLogin = () => {
    window.location.href = `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/auth/google`;
  };

  const logout = () => {
    clearAuthToken();
    queryClient.setQueryData(["user"], null);
    router.push("/");
  };

  const updateProfile = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (data: UpdateProfileDto) => {
      const response = await api.put<User>("/users/profile", data);
      return response.data;
    },
    onSuccess: (data) => {
      queryClient.setQueryData(["user"], data);
    },
  });

  const updateProfilePhoto = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (formData: FormData) => {
      const response = await api.put<User>("/users/profile/photo", formData, {
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "multipart/form-data",
        },
      });
      return response.data;
    },
    onSuccess: (data) => {
      queryClient.setQueryData(["user"], data);
    },
  });

  return (
    <AuthContext.Provider
      value={{
        user,
        isLoadingUser,
        checkAuth,
        logout,
        handleGoogleLogin,
        loginWithEmail,
        signup,
        registerWithEmail,
        updateProfile,
        updateProfilePhoto,
        onboardCreator,
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </AuthContext.Provider>
  );
}

export const useAuth = () => {
  const context = useContext(AuthContext);
  if (context === undefined) {
    throw new Error("useAuthContext must be used within an AuthProvider");
  }
  return context;
};
